testCase.name: Manifest Permission Missing
testCase.description: SecurityException due to missing CAMERA permission

error.message: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA

agent_response.error: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA
agent_response.rootCause: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA at app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:5
fixGuidelines: 1. Open app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml at line 5 and check if the <uses-permission> tag for CAMERA is present.

2. If not, add the following XML snippet before the <application> tag:

<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />
3. Verify that all necessary permissions are declared in the manifest to prevent runtime exceptions.
